summary: Admin Access Control feature testing completed. All backend API tests (14/14) and frontend UI tests (10/10) PASSED. The feature allows admin to control visibility of Dashboard cards, Capex Request sections, and Analytics modules with toggle ON/OFF, role-based access, user-specific overrides, and permission levels (View Only, Editable, Hidden).

issues: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors: '<th> cannot be child of <span>' - this is a React hydration warning that should be investigated but doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors in Dashboard.jsx table - '<th> cannot be child of <span>' and similar. This is a React hydration warning that should be investigated but doesn't affect functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Access Control feature fully tested and working: 1) Admin can access /api/admin/access-config to get full config with 4 dashboard_cards, 7 request_sections, 6 analytics_modules. 2) Admin can update config via PUT /api/admin/access-config. 3) Admin can reset to defaults via POST /api/admin/access-config/reset. 4) Non-admin users (buyer, capex_head) get 403 on admin endpoints. 5) Any authenticated user can get their resolved permissions via GET /api/access/permissions. 6) Admin gets 'editable' for all items. 7) Buyer gets buyer_module=editable, capex_head_module=hidden. 8) Frontend Access Control tab in Admin panel shows all 3 sections with correct item counts. 9) Each item has toggle, name, description, permission badge, role count. 10) Expanding item shows Permission dropdown, Role Access toggles (6 roles), User Overrides section. 11) Save Changes and Reset Defaults buttons work. 12) Dashboard renders correctly for buyer with widgets visible based on permissions.

backend_get_permissions_capex_head.test: GET /api/access/permissions returns capex_head_module=editable, buyer_module=editable for capex_head

backend_dashboard_cards_structure.test: dashboard_cards has stats, analytics, pending_tasks, recent_requests

backend_request_sections_structure.test: request_sections has 7 items including buyer_module, capex_head_module

frontend_access_control_tab.test: Access Control tab with shield icon visible

frontend_toggle_switches.test: Toggle switches present for all items

frontend_permission_legend.test: Permission legend shows View Only, Editable, Hidden

frontend_expand_item.test: Expanding item shows Permission dropdown, Role Access, User Overrides

frontend_role_toggles.test: 6 role toggles present (Admin, Capex Head, Buyer, Dept Head, Process Eng, User)
